question: ‘Float Festival’ is one of the main festivals celebrated in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madurai**__.

__
 
• **Float Festival is one of the main festivals celebrated in Madurai**__.​​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Float festival which attracts many tourists and pilgrims is one of the main festivals celebrated in Madurai.

 
 
• Float festival is also known as Theppotsavam.
 
• **Significance**: During the festival, the devotees worship God Sundaresa(incarnation of Lord Shiva), Meenakshi(incarnation of Lord Parvati)
 
• It takes place on the full moon night of Tamil month, Thai which falls between mid-January and mid-February
 
• Background: The festival dates back to 17 the century
 
 
• ​It was celebrated first time by Thirumalai Nayak.
 
• An artificial tank was constructed, then Lord Vigneswara temple was built in the middle of the island.
 
• A custom of taking the idols for a boat ride in the tank was initiated by him. 
 
 
 
• Float festival also celebrates the birthday of King Nayak.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kannur** is a city in the south Indian state of Kerala.
 
• **Kanyakumari **is a coastal town in the state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Puducherry** is a Union Territory bounded by southeastern Tamil Nadu state.
